failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Has Prince been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame? Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into a Hall of Fame?' - This is formulated as natural-language yes/no questions rather than keyword/entity search terms. Hop 3 query is identical: 'Has Prince been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame? Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into any Hall of Fame?'

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Has Prince been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame? Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into a Hall of Fame?' Hop 3 query: 'Has Prince been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame? Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into any Hall of Fame?' - Near-identical wording with only minor variation ('a Hall of Fame' vs 'any Hall of Fame'), re-asking the same questions.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: (i) Summary_1 states: 'they contain no information about whether Prince has been inducted into a Hall of Fame'; Summary_2 states: 'Missing information about Prince: If we assume the artist is Prince (based on historical knowledge), the passages contain no information about whether Prince has been inducted into any Hall of Fame.' (ii) Hop 2 query explicitly targets Prince: 'Has Prince been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame?' - Both conditions met for Prince's Hall of Fame status.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: (i) Summary_1 states: 'they contain no information about whether...Patty Jenkins has been inducted into a Hall of Fame'; Summary_2 states: 'Missing information about Patty Jenkins: The passages contain no information about Patty Jenkins or whether she has been inducted into any Hall of Fame.' (ii) Hop 2 query explicitly targets Patty Jenkins: 'Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into a Hall of Fame?' - Both conditions met for Patty Jenkins's Hall of Fame status.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: In the hop 2 solver reasoning, extensive analysis of passages about Patti Scialfa, James Burton, E Street Band, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Rodney Jenkins, and various Hall of Fames that have no connection to Prince or Patty Jenkins. The reasoning enumerates these inductees in detail despite their clear irrelevance to the claim about Prince and Patty Jenkins.
